svg.title: Mockup 11: venues and the venue profile
svg.text: 11 · Venues: the venue profile the superadmin keeps, and the copy each event gets (superadmin, event admin)
Built on the tenants contract's venues: addresses, house rules, Wi-Fi, floor plan, copied into each event (copy-in, never a live link). New: crew notes and the venue's screens.
Use case: the superadmin keeps the hall's lasting facts in one place; an event admin pulls the hall's latest Wi-Fi into their event after the venue changed it
A · A venue at 1280 px: summary band, then panels in a band (amendment 3)
Used by 2 events (Demo Event, live; Demo Event (spring), draft) · can't be deleted while used
